name: crawlforge-mcp-server
description: Web scraping, crawling, deep research and autonomous extraction — 31 MCP tools returning clean Markdown and structured JSON.
long_description:
CrawlForge turns any web page into clean Markdown or structured JSON. It bundles 31 tools: a unified multi-format `scrape`, batch scraping, deep crawling and site mapping, an autonomous `agent` that researches from a plain-English prompt, stealth browsing for bot-protected sites, stateful browser sessions that stay open across calls, pre-built site templates, change tracking, and llms.txt generation. LLM-backed extraction defaults to a local Ollama model, so no third-party AI key is required; OpenAI and Anthropic are opt-in.

Requires a free CrawlForge API key from https://www.crawlforge.dev — tool calls are metered in credits against that account.

tools.name: agent
tools.description: Use this when you need an autonomous agent to research, navigate, and synthesise an answer from the web - no URLs required.

tools.name: analyze_content
tools.description: Use this for NLP metrics on text you already hold - language detection, sentiment, topic extraction, entity recognition, readability score - for content auditing and classification.

tools.name: batch_scrape
tools.description: Use this to scrape 2-50 URLs in one call - product pages, news articles, competitor pages.

tools.name: browser_session
tools.description: Use this to drive a browser across several calls, keeping the page, its cookies and its login in between.

tools.name: crawl_deep
tools.description: Use this to fetch many pages of one site by following links - a knowledge base, a docs index, a full-site audit.

tools.name: deep_research
tools.description: Use this for exhaustive multi-source research on a topic - it searches the web, fetches and analyses sources, detects conflicts, and (when LLM keys or Ollama are configured) synthesizes a report.

tools.name: extract_content
tools.description: Use this for the readable body of an article-style page with ads, nav, footers and boilerplate removed - for RAG ingestion, summarisation, or LLM context.

tools.name: extract_embedded_state
tools.description: Use this when a page's data lives in its embedded JavaScript state rather than its rendered HTML - Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Apollo, Redux, Inertia, Shopify and JSON script blocks.

tools.name: extract_links
tools.description: Use this to list the hyperlinks on one page - a crawl seed list, a broken-link audit, related resources.

tools.name: extract_metadata
tools.description: Use this for a page's SEO metadata only: title, meta description, Open Graph tags, canonical URL, schema.org data.

tools.name: extract_structured
tools.description: Use this to get a specific data shape from a page using a JSON schema when you can describe the fields but not their selectors - product details, job listings, event data.

tools.name: extract_text
tools.description: Use this for a page's plain text or markdown with tags, scripts and styles removed - the cheapest read of a static HTML page.

tools.name: extract_with_llm
tools.description: Extract data from a URL or text using a natural-language prompt.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Use this for a raw HTTP body - JSON, XML, plain text, an API response - or for the status code, headers and response time.

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Use this to generate an llms.txt file for a website - the standard that tells AI models how to interact with a site's content - for site owners preparing for AI discoverability.

tools.name: get_batch_results
tools.description: Retrieve paginated results for a batch_scrape job by the batchId it returned.

tools.name: list_ollama_models
tools.description: List the Ollama models installed locally, to choose a `model` value for extract_with_llm.

tools.name: localization
tools.description: Use this to look up the locale settings of a country - language, Accept-Language header, timezone, currency, search domain, date and number formats - or to run a search targeted at a country (operation:"localize_search").

tools.name: map_site
tools.description: Use this to list a site's URLs without fetching page bodies - reads sitemap.xml when available, otherwise follows links.

tools.name: process_document
tools.description: Use this to extract text from a PDF or DOCX URL or file - research papers, contracts, reports.

tools.name: read_result
tools.description: Use this to read a result that came back with truncated: true and a result_handle - the tool kept the whole result for 1 hour and returned a preview.

tools.name: reddit_search
tools.description: Use this to search Reddit posts or comments, or read a full comment thread - reddit.com blocks direct scraping, so this reads the Arctic Shift community archive instead (free, no Reddit credentials).

tools.name: scrape
tools.description: Use this to read one page - markdown by default, plus HTML, text, links, metadata, branding, a screenshot or LLM-structured JSON, all from one fetch.

tools.name: scrape_structured
tools.description: Use this when you know the exact CSS selectors for the data you want - e.g. a pricing table or product list with consistent markup.

tools.name: scrape_template
tools.description: Use this when you want structured data from a well-known site or platform API without writing custom selectors.

tools.name: scrape_with_actions
tools.description: Use this when you must interact with a page before scraping - login, click buttons, fill forms, scroll, or wait for dynamic content to load - for SPAs, login-gated content, or multi-step flows.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Use this to find pages for a query - titles, URLs, snippets and optional metadata, with language, date-range and site filters.

tools.name: serp_rank
tools.description: Use this to check where a domain ranks in Google's ORGANIC results for a keyword - real SERP position, not search_web's order.

tools.name: stealth_mode
tools.description: Use this when a site blocks normal scraping - Cloudflare, Datadome, or other bot-detection systems.

tools.name: summarize_content
tools.description: Use this to condense text you already hold into a briefing, comparison, or shorter LLM context - extractive (sentence selection) or abstractive (rewrite via Ollama/sampling).

tools.name: track_changes
tools.description: Use this to monitor a URL for content changes over time - competitor pricing, regulation updates, product availability.

crawlforge_api_key.title: CrawlForge API Key
crawlforge_api_key.description: Authenticates the server and meters credit usage. Get a free key at https://www.crawlforge.dev

dataforseo_login.title: DataForSEO Login (optional)
dataforseo_login.description: Only needed for the serp_rank tool, which reports real Google organic positions. Billed to your own DataForSEO account, separately from CrawlForge credits. Leave blank to disable serp_rank.

dataforseo_password.title: DataForSEO Password (optional)
dataforseo_password.description: Password for the DataForSEO account above. Leave blank to disable serp_rank.
